scenes.say: The self-order kiosk. Friend or foe? Honestly, both.
A kiosk is great for the rush and for big orders. But for a regular who wants a hello, a screen is a step backward.
A kiosk won't replace your team. It changes their job, from typing orders to making drinks and talking to guests.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: A kiosk means you need fewer people
props.fact: It moves your team from typing to talking

scenes.say: So if you add one, keep a person at the counter too. Keep the screens short, with one upsell, not five. And greet everyone who walks in, kiosk or not.

props.title: Kiosk, done kindly
steps: Keep a person at the counter
